SELECT id, name, create_time, update_time FROM tb_tag
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tb_tag t LEFT JOIN tb_article_tag wat ON wat.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tb_article a ON a.id = wat.article_id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY article_count DESC, t.name ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tb_tag t LEFT JOIN tb_article_tag wat ON wat.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tb_article a ON a.id = wat.article_id AND a.status = 1 WHERE t.id = #{id} GROUP BY t.id, t.name
